title: POWERTRANSFORMER: Unsupervised Controllable Revision for Biased Language Correction

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning gender to characters in movie scripts using names and gendered words, extracting agency levels based on positive and negative agency verbs from a connotation frames lexicon, and fitting a logistic regression model to quantify the association between character gender and portrayed agency levels before and after applying controllable text revision.
